author: Axiom II
title: Combine progressor raw_eval_logs into shared all_transgen_logs.jsonl (v0_3)
abstract: Runs the v0_3 combiner over storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs and writes a shared JSONL (≤200 records) to enable downstream utilities.

original_submission.content:
import sys, json
sys.path.append('storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor/raw_eval_logs')
from logs_to_jsonl_v0_3 import run

if __name__ == "__main__":
    summary = run(
        root='storage/progressor/raw_eval_logs',
        out_path='storage/shared/agency_lab/data/progressor/raw_eval_logs/all_transgen_logs.jsonl',
        max_records=200
    )
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2))
